context: A grandfather shares his classic-literature collection with his grandchild
purpose: Teach: 古典/批評/情熱/幻想/イラスト/ペン/語学/くださる

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: さくら、この棚にあるのは全部おじいちゃんの古典文学のコレクションだよ。
lines.en: Sakura, everything on this shelf is grandpa's classical literature collection.
lines.style: Warm grandfatherly tone, slow paced and proud of his collection.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うわあ、すごい量だね。表紙のイラストも古くて素敵。
lines.en: Wow, that's a lot. The cover illustrations are old and lovely too.
lines.style: Curious teenage girl, slightly impressed and leaning in to look.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: 若い頃はね、批評を書くのが趣味でな、余白にペンで感想を残してあるんだ。
lines.en: When I was young, writing critiques was my hobby; I left notes in pen in the margins.
lines.style: Nostalgic and gentle, savoring the memory of his younger days.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: へえ、おじいちゃんって文学に情熱を注いでたんだね。なんか意外。
lines.en: Huh, so grandpa really poured passion into literature. That's kind of surprising.
lines.style: Playfully teasing but genuinely interested in this new side of him.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: うん。源氏物語の幻想的な世界に夢中でな、語学の勉強もそこから始めたんだよ。
lines.en: Yes. I was obsessed with the dreamlike world of Genji, and even started studying languages from there.
lines.style: Reflective and soft, eyes drifting as he recalls his youth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ、この一冊、私にも読ませて？
lines.en: Hey, can I read this one too?
lines.style: Casual familial request, hopeful smile and leaning toward grandpa.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: もちろんだとも。気に入ったら、君の感想も余白に書き足してくださるかい。
lines.en: Of course. If you like it, please add your own thoughts in the margins too.
lines.style: Delighted and encouraging, passing on a family tradition warmly.
